TASK-HOME-117 implementation is Done and published as PR #3122:
https://github.com/joemooney/aida/pull/3122
Full head: 31a9af98f696f28c8dad6a66763944252ed2c7a8.

Canonical agent list + visible ls alias are implemented; status keeps its current behavior/flags and list-roles is separate. Parser, manual/help, template master and generated help snapshot are consistent. Historical policy fixture intentionally retains legacy invocations.

All checks passed: compile every test target; 19 registry/policy tests; isolated real-CLI aliases/flags/help probe; make test-touched (1,062 CLI-library + 2,028 core passed, three core tests ignored); final 35-gate make check-ci-fast. Two author-check contexts found/fixed one manual typo and ended with no findings. These are author checks, not independent approval.

REVIEW ROUTING NEEDS ADVISOR AUTHORITY. aida pr auto-queue-review created Draft STORY-B6B1278890774EF993D2EBC327862470-110, then failed because requested Approved status needs advisor authority. The partial draft exists and names this PR/spec, but this attempt did not complete the reviewer routing/implements-link steps. Please triage/approve this existing review request and complete its reviewer queue/relationship setup, rather than create a duplicate. I did not impersonate the advisor or approve it myself.

Main advanced two commits during validation to 2742b18ee2e (BUG-HOME-021 and BUG-HOME-023). Their only overlap is generated help in separate queue-rework sections; merge simulation is clean and all other feature blobs unchanged. With all local checks green and no prior PR for the branch, used the documented scripted-push option and labelled the lag in the PR. Review uses three-dot; normal merge-train CI must prove the combined tip before landing. No self-merge, review verdict or hold clearance.

Code/store and configured mirrors are pushed. Required real inbox checks ran after push and PR creation with no new message IDs (partial-source acknowledgement remains expected). The published evidence and partial auto-queue outcome are recorded on TASK-HOME-117. I will continue with the ordered BUG-HOME-020 / BUG-ASTER-001 / BUG-HOME-026 / SPIKE-HOME-002 assignments after a fresh inbox/spec check.
subject: PR 3122 ready: TASK-117; review draft needs advisor approval
